## Product Catalog & Specifications
1. **Daffodil Yarn**: 2/28 Nm 100% Acrylic Yarn. Certified high-bulk warmth, vibrant color brilliance, pilling resistant. Ideal for hosiery sweaters and school uniforms.
2. **Rainbow Yarn**: 2/26 Nm (82/18 Acrylic/Nylon). Shiny soft yarn blend for designer sweaters and fashion tops.
3. **Hazel Yarn**: 2/28 NM & 2/36 NM (75/25 Viscose/Nylon). Silky touch luxury viscose yarn for cardigans and fashion tops.
4. **Megamix Yarn**: Acrylic/Cotton Slub Effect fine count yarn for textured fashion knitwear.
5. **Vislon 2/48 Yarn**: 2/48 Nm (Viscose/PBT/Nylon). Ultra-fine imported China Vislon yarn featuring silky sheen and smooth drape for 12GG/14GG sweater manufacturing.
6. **E Nigma Yarn**: 550 Denier 100% Polyester heavy textured yarn for structured winterwear, outerwear, and jacket fabrics.
7. **Nylon Hair Yarn**: 0.9 Swad / 0.7 Crystal / 1.3 cm 100% Nylon Eyelash fur hair yarn for fuzzy fashion coats and winter sweaters.
8. **MX Lurex 50/85**: 50/85 Fine Count metallic shimmer Lurex yarn for garment borders, shawls, sarees, and embroidery.
9. **Fancy Jari**: Premium gold and silver fancy zari thread in finest gauges for luxury embroidery and bridalwear.
10. **0.9 & 0.7 Suede Yarn**: Velvety matte peach-skin touch imported China suede yarn for luxury hoodies and plush knitwear.
